Wahab Riaz
Pakistani cricketerWahab Riaz is a Pakistani former cricketer and cricket administrator who was chief selector of Pakistan national cricket team from November 2023 to July 2024. Riaz was a left-arm fast bowler and a right-handed batsman. He frequently bowled at speeds of around 90 mph and had reached 96 miles per hour. His all round performance in ICC Cricket World Cup 2015 earned him worldwide recognition.
